rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Client-facing business lead overseeing commercial due diligence engagements for private equity clients, including project delivery, client relationships, and quality control of AI-assisted research.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience at an MBB firm, in private equity, or in investment banking.
- Experience with commercial due diligence.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Track record of managing complex, deadline-driven workstreams with multiple stakeholders.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
